invariants.rationale: Likely, alignment uses non-negative constants (e.g., Align.LEFT, Align.CENTER, Align.RIGHT) for alignment.
The Align class in gdx typically uses bit flags up to a value like 16, so this captures potential value range.
Bitwise AND with self yields same value; useful if alignment is a bit flag.
alignment almost certainly should not be the minimum int value.
alignment likely is not expected to be the max int value.
